brief: Freelancer at $80/hr to AI agency owner clearing $30k/month. The exact pricing shift, the productization, what AI replaced for me.

slots.title: Stop trading
slots.description: How I escaped the hourly trap and built a $30K/month AI agency using productized service models.

slots.title: Ditch hourly billing
slots.description: I switched from variable hourly quotes to fixed monthly packages that clients could budget around.
slots.badText: Every project required a custom scope and unpredictable invoice totals.
slots.goodText: One standardized price eliminates negotiation and guarantees recurring revenue.

slots.title: Productize your delivery
slots.description: We built repeatable AI workflows that run autonomously instead of manual delivery each time.
slots.badText: I personally wrote every email, report, and strategy deck from scratch.
slots.goodText: Agents handle onboarding, research, and drafts while I oversee results.

slots.title: Replace yourself first
slots.description: I stopped being the bottleneck by delegating execution to specialized AI tools and systems.
slots.badText: My income froze whenever I slept, vacationed, or got sick.
slots.goodText: The agency now operates, delivers, and supports clients around the clock.

slots.title: Narrow your niche
slots.description: Generalist freelancers compete on rates. I chose one vertical and became the obvious premium choice.
slots.badText: I took any gig I could find and raced to the bottom.
slots.goodText: A focused offer let me charge premium rates without price resistance.

slots.title: Sell outcomes not hours
slots.description: Clients pay for results and speed, not how long you sit at a desk.
slots.badText: Clients micromanaged timesheets and questioned every ten-minute block on invoices.
slots.goodText: Fixed monthly fees tied to clear deliverables and business outcomes.

slots.title: Systemize to scale
slots.description: AI replaced the need for junior staff by handling repetitive tasks and client communication.
slots.badText: Scaling meant recruiting, training, and payroll I could not afford yet.
slots.goodText: One operator oversees AI agents that manage ten accounts simultaneously.

slots.body: Stop selling hours. Start selling productized outcomes that scale without adding headcount.
